description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ResetPasswordServiceTest' for testing the ResetPasswordService within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It includes setup for mock services, and multiple test methods covering functionalities like email service retrieval, DAO access, password reset request handling, email content generation, user search, password reset code generation, saving reset passwords, logging requests, URL validation, and user validation.

classes.name: ResetPasswordServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the ResetPasswordService related to password reset processes in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with mock services and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Tests that getEmailService returns an instance of EmailService.

methods.name: testResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Verifies that getResetPasswordDao returns a ResetPasswordDao instance.

methods.name: testHasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Checks that the method correctly identifies non-expired reset requests.

methods.name: testExtractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Tests extraction of metadata from reset codes.

methods.name: testGenerateEmailBody
methods.description: Verifies the generation of email body content with placeholders and replacements.

methods.name: testSearchForUserRecord
methods.description: Tests searching for user records with various search terms.

methods.name: testSendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Tests email sending functionality for password reset codes, using mock URL generation.

methods.name: testGeneratePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Checks that generated reset codes include the username metadata.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Validates saving reset passwords with correct and incorrect credentials.

methods.name: testLogPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Tests logging of password reset requests, including mock URL generation and method expectations.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Tests validation of reset URLs, expecting null for invalid codes.

methods.name: testValidateUser
methods.description: Verifies user validation logic for different user records.
